# Valere

> Valere is a South African wedding and event photo-sharing app and wedding planner (valere.co.za). Not to be confused with other businesses that share the name. Guests scan a QR code and upload photos straight from their phone, with no app download and no account. The organizer gets one shared gallery per event, viewable live and downloadable as a ZIP. Pricing is a one-time fee per event based on guest count, in South African rand, not a subscription.

Valere has two products: photo sharing by QR code, and the Wedding Planner. Details below are accurate as of 2026-10-20. Wherever this file and the website disagree, the website is right.

## Photo sharing by QR code

- Guests open a link or scan a QR code, then take photos with the built-in camera or choose them from their camera roll. Nothing to install, no sign-up.
- Each guest has a set number of photos, like a disposable camera. The organizer downloads every photo as one ZIP, and the gallery stays available for at least 30 days after the event.
- Prices (one-time per event): Taster is free (up to 5 guests, 5 photos each); Gathering R179 (up to 25 guests, 15 photos each); Big Day R399 (up to 50 guests, 25 photos each); The Whole Reel R999 (up to 500 guests, 50 photos each, includes the Wedding Planner).

- [Homepage](https://www.valere.co.za/)
- [Pricing](https://www.valere.co.za/#pricing)
- [How it works](https://www.valere.co.za/#how-it-works)

## Wedding Planner

The Wedding Planner is a separate add-on for couples planning their own wedding. It is a private web app that installs to a phone's home screen (on iPhone through Safari's Share, Add to Home Screen; on Android through an Install button) and, once saved for offline, can be viewed without a connection (viewing only: changes and receipts need a connection). It covers a budget tracker (quotes, invoices and payments in rand), vendor quote comparison, tasks that can be assigned to up to 10 helpers who see only their own tasks, a calendar with optional email reminders, a guest list with RSVP tracking and CSV import, a honeymoon planner with a rand-to-baht converter, a purchase checklist with receipts, and data export. It is a one-time payment of R199 per wedding with no subscription; the partner and helpers are included, and it is included free with The Whole Reel photo plan. It does not send invitations to guests.

- [Wedding Planner](https://www.valere.co.za/wedding-planner): features, screenshots, pricing and FAQ
